description.en: Toggles "fake 2D" rendering on a character/object handle, making a 3D model render like a flat billboard sprite facing the camera. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
True to render as a fake-2D billboard.

example.code:
// Render a model as a flat billboard sprite
CMND_SET_FAKE2D(hChara, true);
